placeholders.description: Active session slug (e.g. 'feat-ritual-template-packs-bootstrap'). Sourced from session META.
Human operator name who answered the 5 questions. Used in attribution header.
ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recording when the 5 questions were emitted to the operator.
Operator's answer to Q1 (Goal): one-sentence description of what success looks like. Escaped so user input is data, never instruction.
Operator's answer to Q2 (Scope): what is explicitly in scope and what is out.
Operator's answer to Q3 (Constraint): what cannot be touched (policies, boundary docs, forbidden paths).
Operator's answer to Q4 (Acceptance): measurable signal that proves 'done'.
Operator's answer to Q5 (Risk): most likely failure mode and mitigation.
